_why_beta: Mainland-China regulatory risk and ADR discount make the regression beta unreliable; use 1.3 for a China-exposed online broker

dcf._why: Revenue = brokerage commission + interest income + other. Q2-26 revenue +36%, but the CSRC fine (RMB1.85B, May 2026) bars mainland clients from adding funds for two years, so growth fades from 20% to 6%. Pre-tax margin: 45% TTM is near peak (rate-sensitive interest income); fades to 38%. Broker needs little capex; reinvestment 10% of new revenue for regulatory capital.

ddm._why: No regular dividend (buyback instead); DDM not meaningful

_why_rule1_growth: Capped at 15%; hist 5y EPS growth 52% but consensus FY27 +20% and mainland run-off drag.
